title: JTPA job-training study
content: Motivation confounds program signup, service attendance, and earnings. Signed Up affects Showed Up, which affects Earnings, but the Motivation-to-Showed-Up arrow leaves that mediator unshielded; strict front-door identification therefore fails.

variables.name: Motivation
variables.content: The unobserved common cause affecting participation and earnings.

variables.name: Signed Up
variables.content: Whether a person registered for the program.

variables.name: Showed Up
variables.content: Whether an enrollee actually used the services.

variables.name: Earnings
variables.content: Earnings during the subsequent eighteen months.

arrows.because: Motivation affects whether a person signs up.
Figure 7.3 includes the unshielding Motivation-to-Showed-Up arrow.
Motivation affects later earnings independently of services.
A person must sign up before showing up for services.
The program can affect earnings only if the enrollee uses the services.
